doctorAbout.full_description: Dr. Nidhi Tandon is a highly accomplished medical oncologist, renowned for her expertise in advanced cancer treatments like targeted therapy and immunotherapy. After receiving her oncology training from two of the world's most prestigious institutions, Tata Memorial Hospital in India and the Mayo Clinic in the United States, she's practising as a clinical and academic lead of medical oncology and advisor to oncology collegium at Narayana Health City, Bengaluru. Apart from authoring more than 50 research articles in various national and international journals, she is also the recipient of prestigious awards like the Conquer Cancer Merit award from American Society of Clinical Oncology, SIOP Scholarship from International Society of Paediatric Oncology and Best Thesis Award at Indian Oncology Cooperative Network. She is also a mentor and guide to DNB Oncology students. Her clinical acumen, coupled with a passion for innovation, positions her as a leading figure in the evolving landscape of oncology.

items.text: Recognized for her outstanding contributions in oncology, Dr. Tandon has received prestigious awards and scholarships.
Conquer Cancer Merit Award for a poster presentation at the ASCO annual meeting in 2016.
SIOP Scholarship for a poster presentation at the 46th Congress of the International Society of Pediatric Oncology in 2014.
Best thesis award at the 30th Annual Meeting of the Indian Oncology Cooperative Network in 2014.
Travel Scholarship for ACORD Workshop on Cancer Clinical Research Methods in 2012.
Dr. Tandon has made significant contributions to the field of oncology literature.
Multiple presentations at various international conferences.
Authored various original articles, review articles, editorials, and book chapters in peer-reviewed journals and international books.
Active member of prestigious medical associations.
Indian Society of Medical and Pediatric Oncology.
